overview.tagline: I build things for the web
overview.intro: I am a Software Developement Engineer - III at Upstox, Mumbai. Specializes in back-end development sometime designing and developing front end as well, Also having interest in competitive programming.

introduction: Computers always fascinated me I knew that I wanted to do something related to it. So I joined college for pursuing computer science where I managed to learn about programming and how computers works, During this time I explored lot of Computer Science fields but found my interest to be in the webservices, Specifically in the backend development.

When I graduated, I joined the NetCracker Technology as an Junior Java Developer ( Backend ) and have been here since! I'm now a Software Developer on the Test Automation Team and over the last year, I've automated test cases covering more than 70% features of the product for back-end as well as front-end.

Outside of work, I am also active on competitive programming sites like CodeChef and CodeForces, competing with similar minds. I've highest rating of 1771 on CodeChef and beginner profile on CodeForces. I frequently challenge myself with data structure and algorithm problems on leetcode as well.

description: During my time at NetCracker, I had the opportunity to work on cutting-edge technologies including Spring Boot, React, OpenShift, Kubernetes, and Docker. I began my journey as a Junior Software Engineer, focusing on bug fixes, unit testing, and code quality improvements.

I gained extensive knowledge of microservices architecture, REST API development, and system design concepts. I was a key member of a team responsible for developing the backend components of several critical microservices.

Later, I transitioned to the Test Automation team, where I automated QA test cases for end-to-end flows covering both frontend and backend. Initially focused on backend automation, I gradually expanded to frontend testing using frameworks like TestCafe, acquiring valuable JavaScript skills alongside my primary expertise in Java.

At Upstox, I serve as a Senior Software Engineer (SDE-II), contributing to the development of high-performance financial trading platforms. My role involves designing and implementing scalable backend services using Java and Spring Boot.

I am responsible for optimizing existing systems for lower latency and higher throughput, ensuring a seamless trading experience for millions of users. I also collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to integrate new features and maintain system reliability in a fast-paced fintech environment.
Beyond backend development, I occasionally contribute to frontend tasks and actively participate in architectural discussions to drive technical excellence and innovation within the team.

projects.title: Static website using vue
description: Simple single page static website developed using Vue JS to create online presence of the local restaurant business. Future plans include to transform it into dynamic website where users will be able place orders.
Main focus while building this website was user experience and user interface. Faced many challenged while finalizing the design.

projects.title: Static website using vue
description: My first ever website. So will always be closer to my heart. Client who is also my friend wanted to create a simple website not too complicated just for showcasing their projects. So delivered it in no time.
Main focus while developing the website was to deliver it in under a week.
